training_split.method: hold out 25 and 60 degree elevation rings at each radius shell in lattice and pile; exclude two adjacent boundary frames on either side; hold out complete pier scene for final synthetic test

physical_scene.reason: The pinned snapshot omits the undistorted RGB images that the dataset README says should be in gt_depth; raw captures cannot be paired with pseudo-reference maps.

loader_review.supervision_scope: masked rebar-interior metric optical-axis Z in meters; target range 0.001–20 m
limits: The upstream paper evaluation scenes are used with this independent split; published benchmark results are not reproduced.
Physical COLMAP/ArUco pseudo-reference is not evaluated because aligned RGB is absent.
Depth values above the model 20 m range are excluded from supervision.
